observed_full_episode_journal_secondary.interpretation: The historical acceptance journal preserves subsequently revoked HS; the retained-after-repairs matching and final counters are separate. HS cancellation records are repairs rather than physiological zero-duration stances. Actor-valid cycles remain distinct from binary events and agreement with measured contact; an unanchored startup TO remains an explicit extra against the complete-cycle oracle. Secondary observed journal only: before any primary support its reference is startup only. Startup resetHS is initialization; unmatched references beyond saved support are unknown and never physiological failure counts.

pooled.definition: Sum actual force impulses from three exact nominal swing windows / same primary_all impulse, inherited saved-data quadrature; no clamping or recomputation

limitations: Measured healthy-limb20N nominal events are production references, not ground truth of the virtual prosthetic limb.
Binary geometry plane/points, empirical force basis/plane and renderedSTL sole are different constructions; timing disagreement does not uniquely identify registration error.
Actor counters and retained cycle events are algorithmic diagnostics, not independent physiological cycles.
All inherited tolerances are diagnostic pairing references only; no new acceptance, hardware, subject or gait gate.
